posts.title: You've Been Doing Harness Engineering All Along
posts.description: If you used LLMs for coding before the coding agents (~prior to Claude Code release in Feb last year), and if you got annoyed with typing the same context into LLM chat boxes, you’d start saving it into per-project markdown files. posts.title: Lessons from going solo
posts.description: A large percentage of people I hang out with work in tech. Most of them have only ever known salaried 9-to-5 jobs.
